verdict.rationale: Netlify's integrations directory lists first-party-hosted starters and templates for common use cases: a Remix + Supabase starter, a bare-bones Angular project ready to deploy, and a Clerk B2C auth template. However, the evidence never documents a one-click deploy mechanism, such as a deploy button or template gallery flow, and covers only a few examples. missing for 10: explicit one-click deploy flow documentation, evidence of a broad template catalog across use cases, independent or hands-on corroboration of deploying a template.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases

citations.quote: The Remix Supabase starter demonstrates how to integrate Supabase into an Remix project deployed on Netlify.
This is a bare-bones Angular project that has everything you need to quickly deploy it to Netlify.
The Clerk B2C template on Netlify makes it simple to launch a production-ready B2C application with authentication and user management
